WITH scan_ratios AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry AS sitecode,
         s.healtheval AS healthstatus,
         sc.gbsize::double precision / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0) AS ratio
  FROM scans sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  WHERE sc.chronotag::text BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT sitecode,
         healthstatus,
         AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scan_ratios
  GROUP BY sitecode, healthstatus
),
mean_stat AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT g.sitecode,
       g.healthstatus,
       g.avg_ratio,
       g.scan_count,
       g.avg_ratio - m.mean_avg AS beat_by
FROM group_stats g
CROSS JOIN mean_stat m
WHERE g.avg_ratio > m.mean_avg
ORDER BY beat_by DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
